fn:TURING:turing:main.description: Initializes and runs a Turing machine simulation using hardcoded tape and state table data, printing initial and final tape states to screen.

fn:TURING:turing:TuringMachine::getSymbo.description: Returns symbol from tape at given position, extending tape dynamically as needed. Works with internal tape data structure, handles negative and out-of-bounds indices.

fn:TURING:turing:TuringMachine::setSymbo.description: Sets a symbol on the tape at the given position, returning the symbol written. Works with the internal tape data structure.

fn:TURING:turing:TuringMachine::step.description: Advances the Turing machine by one step using the state table, modifying tape symbol and position based on current state and input symbol.

fn:TURING:turing:TuringMachine::tapeStri.description: Converts tape contents to string of 0s and 1s for display. Works with internal tape data structure, returns dynamically allocated character string.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:CountSym.description: Counts consecutive identical symbols around current tape position, displays count at cursor, waits for keypress before clearing display. Works with tape data structure and screen output.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:Cursor.description: Sets cursor visibility range on screen display using BIOS interrupt $10. Parameters define start and end scan lines for cursor appearance.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:DrawMachine.description: Draws Turing machine instruction table on screen grid, showing state-symbol combinations and their instructions from data structure.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:DrawTape.description: Draws tape contents on screen starting at position At using Translator table. Updates LeftPosition to track displayed range. Works with Screen array and Tape data structure.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:EditInstruct.description: Edits a Turing machine instruction at the current state and symbol position, updating screen display and handling state transitions. Works with screen coordinates and internal machine data structure.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:ExecuteInstruct.description: Executes a single instruction from the Turing machine program, updating the tape, state, and carriage position. Works with screen display and keyboard input during trace mode.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:Initialize.description: Initializes Turing machine state, sets default values for tape, machine name, and edit flag, then draws initial tape and machine display.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:LoadMachine.description: Loads Turing machine instructions from a file into memory, displays the machine name and initial state, and prepares the machine for editing or execution. Works with file I/O and screen display.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:LoadTape.description: Loads tape data from a file into memory, displays the filename, and updates the tape display. Works with file I/O and screen output.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:NullInstruct.description: Initializes a Turing machine instruction table entry for a null instruction, setting write symbol, next state, and move direction. Works with the internal machine state data structure.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:ReadKbd.description: Reads keyboard input from Kbd file handle, detects escape key presses, sets Escape flag accordingly. Works with standard input device.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:SaveMachine.description: Saves current machine state to a file with specified name. Works with screen input, data structure, and file I/O.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:SaveTape.description: Saves current tape segment to a file with specified name. Works with tape data structure and screen input editing.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:WriteInstruct.description: Writes Turing machine instruction to screen display at position determined by state and symbol. Works with global Machine data structure and screen output.

fn:TURING:TuringMachine:WriteScreen.description: Copies the Turing machine window contents to the screen buffer for display. Works with screen and TuringWindow data structures.

fn:theWheel:oItem:dActivation.description: Updates item activation value and propagates change to parent view's total activation. Works with activation data structure and view hierarchy.

fn:theWheel:oItem:Dump.description: Outputs object state information during debugging via dump context, typically to screen or debug output stream.

fn:theWheel:oItem:getWidth.description: Returns scaled width for an item based on its activation relative to parent's total activation, using a global SCALE factor. Works with activation data structures during layout calculations.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnEditClear.description: Clears current selection from view, deletes associated data structure, and updates all document views to reflect removal. Works with in-memory selection data structure and document view system.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnEditCopy.description: Copies selected items to the clipboard. Works with the current selection data structure and clipboard functionality.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnLButtonDblClk.description: Handles double-clicking on selected items, opening them with primary or open verb based on control key state, then calls base class implementation. Works with view selection and OLE verbs.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnLButtonDown.description: Handles left mouse button down events for item selection and potential resizing within the visualization window. Works with screen coordinates and item data structures.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnUpdateEditClear.description: Enables or disables the edit clear command based on whether a selection exists. Works with the mySelection data structure to determine state.

fn:theWheel:oView:OnUpdateEditCopy.description: Enables or disables the Edit/Copy menu item based on whether a selection exists. Works with the mySelection data structure and UI command update mechanism.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnEditClear.description: Clears current selection from view, removes it from document, and updates all views to reflect the change. Works with selection data structure and document's view system.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnEditCopy.description: Copies selected items to the clipboard. Works with the current selection data structure and clipboard.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnLButtonDblClk.description: Handles left mouse button double-click to open selected item with primary or open verb based on control key state, then calls base class implementation. Works with screen coordinates and selection data structure.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnLButtonDown.description: Handles left mouse button down events for item selection and potential resizing within the view. Works with screen coordinates and item data structures.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnUpdateEditCle.description: Enables or disables the edit clear command based on whether a selection exists. Works with the mySelection data structure to determine state.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::OnUpdateEditCop.description: Enables or disables the Edit/Copy menu item based on whether a selection exists. Works with the mySelection data structure to determine copy availability.

fn:theWheel:oView:oView::SetupTracker.description: Configures a rectangle tracker for visual item editing, setting style and positioning based on item type and state. Works with screen display elements and item data structures.

fn:theWheel:oView:SetupTracker.description: Configures a rectangle tracker for visual item editing, setting its style and constraints based on item type, selection state, and display requirements. Works with screen rendering structures.

fn:theWheel:theWheel:theWheelApp::IsIdle.description: Filters out idle messages and timer messages, returning false for these cases to prevent unnecessary processing during application idle time. Works with Windows message queue during application runtime.

fn:theWheel:theWheel:theWheelApp::OnFile.description: Creates a new root object and initializes child views in the main frame window. Works with wlEevorg objects and wlChildView elements in the spreading activation network visualization.

fn:theWheel:theWheel.~cp:branch.description: Creates branching child elements in a spreading activation network visualization, recursively building hierarchical structures from a parent node. Works with wlFrameView, wlEevorg, and wlChildView objects to generate nested visual representations.

fn:theWheel:theWheel.~cp:theWheelApp::Ru.description: Main message loop handler managing window messages and idle processing for theWheel application's graphical interface and data visualization.

fn:theWheel:wlChild:wlChild::updateSize.description: Updates the size of a child window based on mouse position and spreading activation network calculations, modifying visual representation during graph browsing.

fn:theWheel:wlchildv:wlChildView.description: Constructs a child view for a wheel object, initializes position and size based on aspect hint, and creates the window within the frame view.

fn:theWheel:wlchildv:wlChildView::Draw.description: Draws object content to a compatible DC and stretches it to target bounds for screen display. Uses off-screen buffer for rendering, works with CDC device contexts and object data structure.

fn:theWheel:wlChildW:computeAlphaBeta.description: Computes alpha and beta values using square root of discriminant. Works with spring constant and damping coefficient values.

fn:theWheel:wlChildW:computeCaCb.description: Computes coefficients c_a and c_b for spring force calculation using current position and velocity. Works with spring geometry and damping parameters from wlSpring object.

fn:theWheel:wlChildW:dydt.description: Computes derivative of spring force using exponential decay table lookup. Works with spring dynamics in spreading activation network visualization.

fn:theWheel:wlChildW:y.description: Returns y-coordinate for spring animation at time t using exponential decay functions and lookup table for smooth motion interpolation.

fn:theWheel:Wldoc:getAt.description: Retrieves a character from a square matrix stored in memory, using offset coordinates relative to matrix center. Works with character matrices representing visual data structures.

fn:theWheel:Wldoc:wlObject::grow.description: Grows a cellular automaton grid by one unit in each direction, applying transition rules based on neighboring cell sums. Works with internal char grid structure using getAt/setAt accessors.

fn:theWheel:wlEevorg:nextGen.description: Generates next sequence in cellular automaton rule application, working with byte arrays for state transitions and rule lookups.

fn:theWheel:wlEevorg:Serialize.description: Serializes maxVal and maxRule values, along with rule data structure to/from archive files during save/load operations.

fn:theWheel:wleevorg:wlEevorg::AssertVal.description: Validates internal state of eevorg object, checking rule limits against rule set size and calling base class validation. Works with internal data structure containing rules and their constraints.

fn:theWheel:wleevorg:wlEevorg::Dump.description: Outputs object state information during debugging. Works with dump context for serialization of internal data structure contents.

fn:theWheel:wleevorg:wlEevorg::nextGen.description: Generates next sequence in cellular automaton rule application, working with byte arrays for state transitions and rule lookup.

fn:theWheel:wleevorg:wlEevorg::Serialize.description: Serializes maxVal, maxRule, and rule members to/from archive for file-based persistence of organization data structure.

fn:theWheel:wlFrame:wlFrame::Dump.description: Outputs frame state information during debugging. Works with dump context for serialization.

fn:theWheel:wlframev:wlFrameView.description: Constructor initializes frame view members, sets child pointers to NULL, and total area to zero. Works with MDI child views and manages their layout within the frame window.

fn:theWheel:wlframev:wlFrameView::Assert.description: Validates frame view's child objects and area integrity, called during debugging to check internal state consistency.

fn:theWheel:wlframev:wlFrameView::setChi.description: Sets a child view in the next available slot of the child array. Works with the internal data structure managing multiple child views.

fn:theWheel:wlObject:delLink.description: Removes a link to the specified object from this object's link collection. Works with internal data structure of links, returns true if link was present and removed.

fn:theWheel:wlObject:getAspectHint.description: Calculates square aspect ratio for given area, returns rectangle dimensions for object sizing during visualization updates. Works with screen coordinates and layout calculations.

fn:theWheel:wlObject:getNextLink.description: Returns next link in object's association list during iteration, works with internal wlObjectLink data structure.

fn:theWheel:wlObject:operator=.description: Assignment operator for object link, copies target reference and weight values from another link object. Works with internal data structure representing network connections.

fn:theWheel:wlobject:wlObject::getAspect.description: Calculates square aspect ratio for given area, returns rectangle dimensions for object sizing during visualization updates. Works with screen area measurements and CRect data structures.

fn:theWheel:wlObject:wlObject::getLinkBy.description: Returns link object pointing to specified target object, or NULL if no such link exists. Works with internal object link collection data structure.

fn:theWheel:wlobject:wlObject::OnNewDocu.description: Initializes a new document for the knowledge visualization system. Handles basic document creation setup for spreading activation network editing with CoolDraw rendering.

fn:theWheel:wlobject:wlObjectLink.description: Constructs a link to another object with specified weight; initializes target pointer and weight value for spreading activation network connections.

fn:theWheel:wlobject:wlObjectLink::Seria.description: Serializes link weight data; reads or writes to archive during file operations.

fn:theWheel:wlpyram:wlPyramid::initKerne.description: Initializes Gaussian kernel arrays for pyramid processing. Creates three kernels for normal, first derivative, and second derivative Gaussian functions using precomputed values.

fn:theWheel:wlpyram:wlPyramid::original.description: Returns first element of g array. Works with internal data structure array g, accessed by index 0.

fn:theWheel:wlpyram:wlPyramid::update.description: Updates pyramid by convolving and decimating signals across levels using Gaussian kernels. Works with internal signal data structures.

fn:theWheel:wlsignal:wlSignal::addSample.description: Maintains a sliding window of signal samples, shifting old values and storing new ones. Works with internal sample array, updates counter.

fn:theWheel:wlsignal:wlSignal::convolve.description: Convolve applies a kernel filter to signal samples, sliding window convolution operation on internal signal data structure.

fn:theWheel:wlsignal:wlSignal::decimate.description: Reduces signal sample rate by half, keeping every second sample. Works with internal sample buffer s, updates rate and count variables.

fn:theWheel:wlSpring:eval.description: Evaluates spring force terms using exponential decay functions. Computes position and velocity based on time input and spring parameters.

fn:theWheel:wlSpring:reset.description: Initializes spring parameters using evaluation at start time. Sets up spring dynamics with given initial time and position values.

fn:theWheel:wlSpring:wlSpring.description: Destructor for wlSpring class, handles cleanup of spreading activation network spring-based graph elements and their visual representations in CoolDraw rendering.

fn:theWheel:wluser:beginSession.description: Initializes a user session, logs version and start time information to the session log file.

fn:theWheel:wluser:endSession.description: Ends the user session by logging termination time to the session log file. Works with the sessionLog data structure and writes timestamp information.

fn:theWheel:wlView:wlView::removeReferen.description: Removes references from views in a map by calling delLink on each, clearing associations between view objects and the current view. Works with CMapPtrToPtr data structure containing view-object mappings.
